import pandas as pd
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder

# Dataset with ordinal categorical variable
data = {
    'education': ['High School', 'Bachelors', 'Masters', 'PhD', 'Bachelors', 'Masters'],
    'experience': [2, 5, 8, 12, 4, 7],
    'salary': [30000, 50000, 70000, 90000, 45000, 65000]
}
df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Create a LabelEncoder instance
le = LabelEncoder()

# Fit and transform the education column
df['education_encoded'] = le.fit_transform(df['education'])

# Create a mapping dictionary to show category to encoding
mapping = dict(zip(le.classes_, range(len(le.classes_))))

# Print the encoded dataframe with the mapping
print("Category to Encoding Mapping:")
for cat, enc in mapping.items():
    print(f"  {cat}: {enc}")
print("\nEncoded DataFrame:")
print(df)
